summary: Iteration 9 (YT-Music-style Home refresh: liquid-refresh pill + spinning home-refresh icon + reshuffled feed + rebuilt mixes) FULLY VERIFIED. BACKEND (test_iteration9.py, 1/1 passed): GET /api/home/mixes?device_id=tester-refresh&refresh=true called twice — both return 200, body has {day, mixes[]}, mixes list is non-empty, each mix has id and non-empty tracks[]. Same-day deterministic seed can return identical mix ids (acceptable per spec). Cleanup via pytest module fixture removes db.libraries and db.mixes_cache entries matching device_id 'tester-refresh'. FRONTEND (390x844 web preview, mobile viewport): Home loads with 3 Made-for-you mix cards (mix-discover-mix, mix-lang-hindi, mix-lang-english). Featured hero title BEFORE tap: 'Zihaal e Miskin' (Javed-Mohsin, Vishal Mishra). Trending in For You (first 3 artwork cards): Humnava Mere, Sang Rahiyo, Heeriye (feat. Arijit Singh). Tapped home-refresh → within 500ms the liquid-refresh pill with text 'Refreshing your feed…' appeared (testID liquid-refresh). Sampled the Animated.View transform inside home-refresh at two moments during refresh — sample 1: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0), sample 2: matrix(0.173648, 0.984808, -0.984808, 0.173648, 0, 0) → icon IS rotating (~80°). The icon colour turns brandPrimary while refreshing (refreshing ? colors.brandPrimary : colors.onSurface, index.tsx:132). Pill disappeared within ~1.5s (well under the 10s bound). After refresh: hero title CHANGED to 'Tu hai kahan' (AUR) — feed IS reshuffled. Header still sticky (home-refresh remains visible at the top). Pill count = 0 after completion. Second home-refresh tap: pill re-appears (count = 1, no duplicate pills; refreshing-guard `if (refreshing) return` in onRefresh prevents concurrent triggers). Icon transform after 2nd refresh returns to matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) (identity) — cancelAnimation(spin) + withTiming(0) works. 0 console errors captured on load or during refresh. Pull-to-refresh: Playwright cannot reliably trigger React Native RefreshControl over the web preview (Web can't dispatch native touch drag onto RN ScrollView RefreshControl) — reported as untestable-on-web per spec (not a failure). REGRESSION SMOKE: Tapped track-row-ONF6k3l- (from 'More to explore') → mini-player appeared with 'Kabhi Shaam Dhale / Mohammad Faiz, Jaani' ✓. mix-discover-mix (with scrollIntoView) → mix-screen renders → mix-back returns to home-screen ✓. home-search-shortcut → search-screen with search-input; typed 'arijit' → suggestion-list rendered with suggest-text-*, suggest-fill-*, suggest-entity-artist-* and suggest-entity-song-* items (Arijit Singh + Gehra Hua + Tum Hi Ho + Pritam & Arijit Singh + song entities). Search suggestions still work end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: React Native RefreshControl cannot be triggered from Playwright web touchscreen/drag — expected on web; native only.
Chromium HTMLAudio still can't decode JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4; mini-player becomes visible on track/mix tap but audio doesn't actually play on web (not blocking on native).

critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx onRefresh (line 77-97): correctly guards re-entry with `if (refreshing) return`, kicks a haptic.medium(), starts an infinite withRepeat(withTiming(360, 900ms)) spin, awaits Promise.all([refetch trending, invalidateQueries library, fetchMixes(deviceId, true) → setQueryData]), then in finally cancelAnimation(spin) + spin.value = withTiming(0, 200) + setRefreshing(false). Nice — the guard means the icon transform is quiescent (identity) whenever refreshing=false, matching the observed after-state.

index.tsx feedSeed shuffle (line 99-109): deterministic Lehmer LCG on feedSeed produces a Fisher-Yates permutation of `tracks`. This means (a) hero and trendingRow shift with every refresh, verified by hero 'Zihaal e Miskin' → 'Tu hai kahan'; (b) the same trending list is used inside the same session, so shufflings are stable per feedSeed. Only tiny nit: `Math.floor((seed/233280)*(i+1))` can produce j==i (identity swap) which is fine.

liquid-refresh.tsx (85 lines): clean component. Uses `if (!visible) return null` so it unmounts when refreshing→false, letting FadeOutUp.duration(220) exit animation run before removal. Blob mounts three independently-animating shared values; the effect cleanup calls cancelAnimation on unmount → no leaked reanimated handles. testID='liquid-refresh' on the pill (line 57) is exactly what the spec asked for.

index.tsx RefreshControl (line 199-208): wired to the same onRefresh + refreshing state, so pull-to-refresh (native) will trigger the same reshuffle+mixes rebuild. `progressViewOffset={insets.top+60}` places the native pull indicator below the sticky header — good.
index.tsx Animated.View key=`feed-${feedSeed}` (line 212): forces remount + LinearTransition.springify() layout animation of the reshuffled feed section. That is why the visual re-order feels smooth.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-9 surface (home-refresh pill + rotating tinted icon + feed reshuffle + Made-for-you rebuild + no duplicate pills + no console errors) + regression smoke (track-row→mini-player, mix card→mix-screen→mix-back, search suggestions)
